title: Urban Evolution and Ecology Conference
level: Researchers (as stated on the conference page)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Urban Evolution and Ecology" takes place from 31 January to 5 February 2027 at the Ventura Beach Marriott in Ventura, California. Applications are submitted through the conference page on grc.org.
